description: This file defines the class 'default_formatter', a generic formatter for connectors in SuiteCRM, handling template rendering and source configuration.

classes.name: default_formatter
classes.description: A generic connector formatter class for SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering templates and managing source configurations.

methods.name: getDetailViewFormat
methods.description: Generates the detail view format by selecting appropriate templates based on source class and configuration.

methods.name: getEditViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for edit view format.

methods.name: getListViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for list view format.

methods.name: getSearchFormFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for search form format.

methods.name: fetchSmarty
methods.description: Fetches the Smarty template based on source class and module, with fallback to default templates.

methods.name: getSourceMapping
methods.description: Returns the mapping configuration from the source component.

methods.name: setSmarty
methods.description: Sets the Smarty template engine instance.

methods.name: getSmarty
methods.description: Returns the current Smarty template engine instance.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Sets the component associated with this formatter.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the component associated with this formatter.

methods.name: getIconFilePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for icon file path.
